commits.summary: The skill version increased to 1.1.0, and its description now covers platform-selection and setup requests where a Google product may be relevant even if none is named.

commits.subject: Fix defects in finding-google-skills, and correct the google-cloud-developer homepage
commits.summary: Expanded catalog-retrieval guidance with filtering and temporary chunked local reading, made certificate failures final without verification bypasses, and clarified that catalogs may be kept only as request-scoped working copies.

commits.subject: Add a skill finder and a generated index of published skills
commits.summary: Added a skill finder that fetches the Google skills catalog on demand, selects and fetches up to three matching skills, and defines retrieval verification and failure handling.
